python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from phase3_generative_loop import load_model, load_features_reference, run_search_loop, export_discoveries
m = load_model()
_, fc = load_features_reference()
res = run_search_loop(m, fc, seed_materials=['SiC','GaN'], generations_per_seed=10, registry_size=10)
df = export_discoveries(res, 'novel_thermal_discoveries.csv', top_n=20)
print('CSV saved:', 'novel_thermal_discoveries.csv')
print('Rows written:', len(df))
print('Columns:', list(df.columns))
print('Top row:', df.iloc[0].to_dict() if len(df) > 0 else 'empty')
"
